title: Show Deployment Package build status
summary: The Maintenance Deployment Package controls now show a visible live status while planning or creating a deployment and after the command completes.
reason: The operator could only infer deployment-package work from disabled controls, which made it unclear whether a build was still running or had finished.
behavior_before: Plan Deployment and Create Deployment only disabled the command buttons and updated small heading text, leaving completion status easy to miss.
behavior_after: The Deployment Package panel renders a prominent aria-live status strip near the command buttons with Planning, Building, Done, warning, and error states.
